and pass them down the table.Aunt Petunia's violet cream puffsThe pudding Dobby floats over the dinner guestsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Little choux puffs baked crisp, filled with vanilla whipped cream and topped with pale violet icing and a sugared violet.Keep them on the plate.Heat the oven to 200°C.Boil 125ml water, 50g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 75g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute.Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs one at a time until glossy.Pipe 20 small mounds on lined trays and bake 20 minutes, then pierce each and bake 5 minutes more.Whip 300ml cream with 2 tbsp icing sugar and vanilla and pipe into the cooled puffs.Mix 120g icing sugar with a little water and a drop of violet colouring and spoon over.Warm cheese scones with butterMr Weasley golden.Flying car beef and mushroom piesThe flying car that ends up in a treeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck braised with mushrooms, onion and stock until tender, baked in individual shortcrust pies with flaky puff lids, with mushy peas and gravy.Brown 1kg diced chuck steak in batches.Soften 1 diced onion and 250g sliced mushrooms, return the beef, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, 1
